annotations.title: Edge Skills: run a live data tool (beta)

description: Run a read-only Edge live data tool from find_tool: LinkedIn, Instagram, company and Google data (free in Edge, a daily number of tool credits) and startup jobs (e.g. tool "rocketlist.search_jobs" with input {"query":"engineer","city":["Berlin"]}). Cite the URLs the results carry. List arguments are arrays.

detail.description: concise (default) keeps the essential fields per result; full returns every field

input.description: Arguments matching the tool's input_schema, as a JSON object

tool.description: The tool id from find_tool, e.g. rocketlist.search_jobs

name: use_tool
